consent.washingtonConsentBanner: Online tracking technologies, such as cookies, are important for the correct functioning of our website. consent.californiaConsentBanner: Online tracking technologies, such as cookies, are important for the correct functioning of our website. consent.washingtonEmailConsent: I consent to receive marketing texts and other communications by email from Anytime Fitness Franchisor LLC (“Anytime”). I can withdraw my consent at any time.
consent.washingtonTextConsent: I'd like to receive promotional offers by text from Anytime, its affiliates, and/or franchisees and their authorized designees, which may be sent by an automated dialing system. Consent is not a condition of purchase. Message and data rates apply.
consent.privacyNotice: By clicking “Submit” below, I consent to receive marketing texts and other communications that may be automated and/or placed with artificial voice, placed by or on behalf of Anytime Fitness Franchisor LLC (“Anytime”) and/or Anytime-brand franchisees, even if my phone number is on a state or national Do Not Call list. Anytime will not share my phone or text information with other affiliates. Further, in clicking “Submit”, I agree to accept the Terms & Conditions, Privacy Notice, and Text Messaging Terms, and attest that I am 18 years of age or older. My consent to receive communications is not a condition of purchase, and I can withdraw my consent at any time. Recurring communications. Message and data rates apply. Text STOP to stop. Add Text HELP for assistance.
consent.contactUsPrivacyNotice: Please review if you are a California resident: For information regarding the categories of personal information collected about you, and the purposes for which your information will be used, please visit Anytime Fitness, LLC's Privacy Notice for California Residents.
consent.localResidentDisclaimerText: I am a Local Resident and at least 18 years old. By checking this box, I confirm that I have read and agree to the Privacy Policy and the website Terms of Use.
consent.marketingConsentDisclaimerText:
By clicking this box, I consent to receive marketing and customer service text messages, that may be automated or placed with an auto-dialer, placed by or on behalf of Anytime Fitness ("Anytime Fitness") and/or my local Anytime Fitness club even if my phone number is on a state or national Do Not Call list. Anytime Fitness will not share my phone or text information with third party affiliates for marketing or any other purpose. My consent to receive communications is not a condition of purchase, and I can withdraw my consent at any time. Recurring communications. Message Frequency may vary. Message and data rates may apply. Text STOP to opt-out at any time. Text HELP for help. SMS & MMS Terms of Service.

For CA residents, please see Notice of Collection for California Residents.
